description:
TMDO is a team of five: Benjamin Martin, Luca Camaño, Tobias Roncati, Valentin Ribero and Trinidad Cruz. 

Córdoba is one of Argentina’s main farming regions, and we built AgroPixel for the producers and agronomists we see there. We split the work into backend, satellite data and deployment, product and rules engine, and two frontend roles. That way we went from raw NASA data to a working web app at agropixel.earth in 48Hs.
